Retired astronaut, former military fighter pilot, test pilot, engineer, and retired U.S. Navy Captain Scott Kelly has seen - and slept in - more places than most. He is a veteran of four space flights and the International Space Station's former commander on three expeditions.  The current American record holder for the most consecutive days in space, Scott is the first American astronaut to spend an entire year among the stars. He has shared the 'wonders of the universe' in multiple books, including Infinite Wonder: An Astronaut's Photographs from a Year in Space and, most notably, Endurance: My Year in Space, A Lifetime of Discovery. Since it was first published, Endurance has become a National Bestseller and is currently in production to turn Scott's fascinating journey among the stars into a feature film.
